result:
Done. Summary of the F13 fix:

**Changes:**

1. **`src/app/nocturne/page.tsx`** — already read the `nocturne_ses` cookie server-side and passed `hasSession` into the provider; updated the comment to document the new broader skip semantics (standalone + no session also skips).

2. **`src/components/nocturne/nocturne-provider.tsx`** — the provider now:
   - accepts `hasSession?: boolean` (explicit `false` skips the probe; `true`/`undefined` probes as before)
   - accepts `isPublic?: boolean` (the public status page's flag — always skips the probe regardless of cookie state)
   - the skip condition is `const skipProbe = isPublic || hasSession === false`
   - removed the dead `demoSession` prop

3. **`src/app/nocturne/status/[slug]/page.tsx`** — the anonymous public surface now mounts `<NocturneProvider isPublic>` and no longer reads the `nocturne_ses` cookie at all (it was passing `hasSession` before, which still let the probe run when the cookie was absent).

4. **`src/components/nocturne/__tests__/nocturne-components.test.tsx`** — 4 new/updated tests:
   - `hasSession=false` mounts without issuing the `/auth/session` fetch
   - `hasSession=true` still probes
   - `isPublic=true` never probes, even with `hasSession=true`
   - the login-screen test now asserts no session fetch was issued
   - `PublicStatusPage` tests use `isPublic: true` and assert no session fetch

**Verification (all green):**
- `bun test src` — 1916 pass, 0 fail
- `bun run typecheck` — clean
- `bun run lint` — 0 errors (4 pre-existing warnings in unrelated files)
- `bun run build` — succeeds
